create_node.title: Register node
create_node.description: Register one thing for the twin to track. The kind is fixed here and cannot be changed afterwards, because every observation recorded against the node carries a copy of it. A node that names no status starts as planned.

get_node.title: Read node
get_node.description: Read one node by its storage key.

list_nodes.title: List nodes
list_nodes.description: List the nodes matching the filter, oldest first. An empty kind or status matches every one.

update_node.title: Update node
update_node.description: Replace a node's name, position, commissioning date, notes and document. The kind never changes, and the status changes only through its own address, so neither is read from this body.

args.description: The node to update. The address decides, not the body.

set_node_status.title: Set node status
set_node_status.description: Move a node through its service life. Only the steps the module allows are accepted, and a decommissioned node is at the end of the road.

create_link.title: Link two nodes
create_link.description: Record a directed edge between two nodes that both already exist. Creating an edge that is already there returns the one that is there, so repeating the call is safe.

delete_link.title: Unlink two nodes
delete_link.description: Remove the single edge the relation and the two ends identify.

args.description: The node the edge points away from.
The node the edge points at.

list_links.title: List links
list_links.description: The single-hop edges touching one node. An empty relation matches every relation, and the direction is outbound unless inbound is asked for.

args.description: Narrows to one relation. Empty matches all.
'inbound' to walk edges pointing at the node; anything else walks outward.

upsert_metric.title: Declare metric
upsert_metric.description: Declare what a measurement is called and what it is read in, or replace the declaration already there. The node kind and the name together identify it.

list_metrics.title: List metrics
list_metrics.description: Every declared measurement, optionally narrowed to one node kind. An empty kind matches all.

args.description: Narrows to one node kind. Empty matches all.

set_retention.title: Set retention rule
set_retention.description: Say how long observations matching a scope are kept, or replace the rule already there. The node kind and the metric name together identify it, and a rule naming a metric must also name a kind.

list_retentions.title: List retention rules
list_retentions.description: Every retention rule. Observations matching no rule are kept indefinitely.

record_observation.title: Record observation
record_observation.description: Store one measurement. Append-only: nothing here edits what was already said, so a wrong value is corrected by recording a further one.

record_observations.title: Record observations
record_observations.description: Store many measurements in one call, which is the path a source that samples often should take. All or nothing: if one is refused, none are stored.

query_observations.title: Query observations
query_observations.description: Observations matching the filter, oldest first. from and to bound the time the measurement was taken; either left out, or not an RFC 3339 instant, leaves that side unbounded.

latest_observations.title: Read current state
latest_observations.description: What one node is doing now. Naming a metric returns that one latest observation; naming none returns the latest of every metric recorded against the node, which is the node's whole current state.

args.description: Narrows to one measurement. Empty returns the latest of each.
